title: 第690章 无言的悲壮第689章 降临的天魔
lines: 第690章无言的悲壮
小瞧人间群雄，终究是要付出代价！
即便那域外天魔首领祭出的法器同样强大无匹，但面对姜无涯祭出的大印，依然显得很脆弱，轰的一声，盾牌四分五裂！
这面曾属于人族修行者的盾牌法器，彻底爆碎！
大印在轰碎盾牌之后，重重砸在域外天魔首领胸口。
咔嚓！
一阵骨头碎裂的声音，域外天魔首领的胸膛直接凹陷进去一大块。
金刚不坏之躯，也禁不起这法器大印的猛砸！
一大口鲜血，顺着域外天魔首领口中喷溅出来。
他一双眼中露出浓郁的恨意光芒，身上爆发出可怕的负面情绪，形成一种场域，瞬间朝着姜无涯那边笼罩过去。
这就是域外天魔的道！
对人族最是有效！
姜无涯身上大道铭文瞬间显现出来。
与这种负面能量场对抗。
同时驾驭着那方大印，继续狠狠砸向这域外天魔首领。
另一边，红尘仙杜老祖眼中闪烁着无尽冰冷的光芒，身上散发出滔天杀机！
那杀机形成实质，化作大道铭文，斩向对面一名同为红尘仙境界的域外天魔。
这一切都只发生在电光石火的刹那间。
速度太快了！
以至于域外天魔这边阵营中另外两个红尘仙境界的强者还没来得及出手，他们这边就已经吃了大亏。
死掉一个，首领重伤，眼看着就要被人用大印活活砸死！
域外天魔这边剩下那两个红尘仙其中一个冲向姜无涯，另一个，则被风老祖给拦住。
捆仙绳已经亮相，再想出其不意的困住对方变得有些困难。
但这名域外天魔的红尘仙同样也被风老祖死死限制住，没办法去另一边进行支援。
姜无涯乘胜追击，得理不饶人，根本不顾法力消耗，驾驭着那方大印，对域外天魔首领穷追猛打。
那个冲向姜无涯的红尘仙速度已经够快，一道神通隔着无尽遥远虚空打向姜无涯，但依然慢了一步！
嘭！
一声闷响！
姜无涯驾驭着那方大印狠狠砸在这群域外天魔首领的头颅之上，将对方的脑袋砸得稀巴烂！
绝世强者之间的对决，若势均力敌，可能会打很久，可一旦平衡被打破，决出胜负也只在瞬息之间。
那道神通打到姜无涯身边，被姜无涯身上亮起的一片八卦光芒挡住。
那八卦光芒中符文光芒璀璨，散发着滔天的大道气息。
这时候，杜老祖那边也已经决出胜负！
对方手中一杆散发着苍凉气息的长枪刺入杜老祖胸膛，直接刺在心脏位置。
杜老祖则用那一身杀气化作无数有形剑气，将对方硬生生斩成无数碎块！
大口大口的鲜血顺着杜老祖口中喷出。
但他却哈哈大笑道：“痛快！”
心脏位置，被对方的杀道打出一个透明大洞，一眼可以看穿，鲜血不断从那里喷涌出来，看着就令人感到揪心。
但杜老祖却浑然不觉似的，再次杀向风老祖那边。
眨眼之间，对方就被人间三名红尘仙干掉三个！
content_en:
Chapter 690 The silent tragedy
If you underestimate the heroes in this world, you will have to pay the price after all!
Even though the magic weapon sacrificed by the leader of the extraterrestrial demon was equally powerful, it still seemed very fragile when faced with the big seal sacrificed by Jiang Wuya. With a bang, the shield fell apart!
This shield weapon that once belonged to a human cultivator was completely shattered!
After the big seal shattered the shield, it hit the chest of the leader of the demon outside the territory.
Click!
There was a sound of bones breaking, and a large piece of the chest of the leader of the extraterrestrial devil sunk directly into it.
Even the indestructible body of Vajra cannot withstand the slamming of the seal of this magic weapon!
A large mouthful of blood spattered out from the mouth of the leader of the demon outside the territory.
His eyes shone with intense hatred, and terrible negative emotions erupted from his body, forming a field that instantly enveloped Jiang Wuya.
This is the way of the demon from outside the territory!
The most effective for humans!
The great inscription on Jiang Wuya's body instantly appeared.
Fight this negative energy field.
At the same time, he controlled the big seal and continued to hit the leader of the extraterrestrial demon.
On the other side, Ancestor Mortal Immortal Du's eyes flashed with endless cold light, and his body exuded murderous intent!
The murderous intention took shape and turned into an inscription on the avenue, slashing at an extraterrestrial demon opposite who was also in the world of mortals.
All this happened in a flash of light.
It's so fast!
So much so that before the other two powerful men in the Red Dust Immortal Realm in the camp of the Outer Territory Demon had a chance to take action, they had already suffered a huge loss.
One person died, the leader was seriously injured, and he was about to be smashed to death with a big seal!
One of the two remaining mortal immortals on the side of the demon outside the territory rushed towards Jiang Wuya, while the other was stopped by Ancestor Feng.
The Immortal Binding Rope has appeared, and it becomes a little difficult to think of unexpected ways to trap the opponent.
But this extraterrestrial devil's mortal immortal was also tightly restrained by Ancestor Feng, and was unable to go to the other side for support.
Jiang Wuya took advantage of the victory and pursued the attack. He was unreasonable and did not care about the consumption of mana. He controlled the big seal and pursued and beat the leader of the demon outside the territory.
The speed of the Hongchen Immortal who rushed towards Jiang Wuya was already fast enough. A magical power hit Jiang Wuya through the endless and distant void, but he was still one step slower!
Bang!
A muffled sound!
Jiang Wuya used the big seal to hit the heads of the leaders of the extraterrestrial demons, smashing their heads to pieces!
A duel between peerless warriors, if evenly matched, may last for a long time, but once the balance is broken, the outcome can only be determined in an instant.
The magical power hit Jiang Wuya, but was blocked by a piece of Bagua light that lit up Jiang Wuya's body.
The runes in the Bagua light shine brightly, exuding the aura of the great avenue.
At this time, Patriarch Du's side has also decided the winner!
A spear exuding a desolate atmosphere in the opponent's hand pierced Old Ancestor Du's chest, directly to his heart.
Ancestor Du used his murderous aura to turn into countless tangible sword auras, cutting the opponent into countless pieces!
Big mouthfuls of blood spurted out from Old Ancestor Du's mouth.
But he laughed loudly and said: "It's so happy!"
At the heart, a large transparent hole was made by the opponent's killing path, which could be seen through at a glance. Blood kept spurting out from there, which was heart-wrenching to watch.
But Old Ancestor Du didn't seem to notice it, and he killed Old Ancestor Feng again.
In the blink of an eye, the opponent was killed by three mortal immortals!
